Portrait setting: The U.A. Sports Festival stadium at midday. Behind the character, a raised square concrete fighting stage sits on the stadium floor, with a flaming brazier on a tall post at each corner; beyond it, steep tiers of seating rise all the way around the oval bowl, filled with a distant crowd rendered as soft blocks of color. Giant video screens stand on the upper rim and plain banners hang from the railings. Open sky above the bowl. No readable signs or text.
